summary: The diff implements `get RegExp.prototype.ignoreCase` as specified. The getter passes the this value and code unit 0x0069 to a file-local `regexp_has_flag` helper, which follows RegExpHasFlag steps 1–5 in order. Step 1 throws a TypeError for non-objects. Step 2 checks for the [[OriginalFlags]] slot via `agent.native::<RegExpData>`. If the slot is missing, step 2a returns undefined when the value is %RegExp.prototype% (via `ops::same_value`), and step 2b otherwise throws a TypeError. Steps 3–5 check whether the flags string contains the code unit. The spec step comments are kept in place. There are no test-specific branches, no swallowed errors, and no placeholder values. The 10 new passing test262 tests fit a change of this size. The only things I could not verify from the diff alone are the helper names it relies on (`RegExpData`, `agent.native`, `agent.intrinsic`, `ops::same_value`); the build passes, so they exist and compile.
